appraisal_events.evidence: il serait possible que j'aille demain chez les Verdurin... Cette hésitation apparente signifiait une volonté arrêtée... Je m'arrangeai pour que la visite à Mme Verdurin n'eût pas lieu... Il rencontrait chez elle la force électrique d'une volonté contraire qui la repoussait vivement
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator decodes Albertine's evasive, hedged announcement as a disguised firm intention, then deliberately maneuvers to block her planned visit to the Verdurins; despite her visible resistance, her plan is thwarted by his arbitrary, tyrannical will.

status_effects.explanation: Albertine's concealed but firmly held plan is overridden despite her resistance, leaving her thwarted in this local contest of wills.

The narrator successfully imposes his inherited, arbitrary need to control those he loves, managing to prevent the visit despite Albertine's opposition, even as he recognizes this tyranny as a fault inherited from his father.
